title: RF-1400 Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Shoei RF-1400 Matte Black is tailored for spirited twisties and aggressive canyon carving. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at 1472g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: The Shoei RF-1400 is the latest in the RF series, focused on lightweight performance and quietness.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for intermediate oval head shapes; features a wide visor opening and adjustable cheek pads for comfort.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced Integrated Matrix Plus (AIM+) 6-layer organic fiber and fiberglass composite shell paired with CWR-F2 3D injection-molded visor with Pinlock EVO lens inserts and vortex generators along the shield edges. The interior utilizes Dual-layer multi-density EPS with internal cooling channels and 3D Max-Dry custom cheek pad fitment with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Shoei RF-1400 Matte Black: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with CWR-F2 3D injection-molded visor with Pinlock EVO lens inserts and vortex generators along the shield edges and Dual-layer multi-density EPS with internal cooling channels and 3D Max-Dry custom cheek pad fitment. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Shoei RF-1400 Matte Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Shoei RF-1400 Matte Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in

qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Shoei RF-1400 Matte Black is a benchmark Aero-Acoustic Premium Touring helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.

ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

introduction: Positioned in Shoei's Full Face lineup, the RF-1400 Matte Black brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Shoei RF-1400 Matte Black represents Shoei's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Shoei RF-1400 Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
